summary: Bug Fix Testing Complete - All 3 critical stability bugs FIXED. TEST 1 (Empty Dashboard): Dashboard shows full UI with data-testid='dashboard-page', search bar, quick actions, donut charts, market insights, and 'Load Demo Data' banner - NOT empty-dashboard. TEST 2 (First Invoice): First purchase saved successfully without crash, dashboard shows $50 spending and 'Based on 1 purchase records'. TEST 3 (Second Save): Second purchase saved without DOM errors, list shows 2 purchases. TEST 4 (Reset + Dashboard): After reset, dashboard shows full UI with $0 values - NOT crash. TEST 5 (Backend): GET /api/dashboard/summary returns valid JSON with all fields (month_raw_materials=0, etc.). TEST 6 (Console): No 'insertBefore', 'Cannot read properties of undefined', or 'Maximum call stack' errors during any flow.

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - Recharts responsive container warning during initial render, does not affect functionality (known cosmetic issue)
